reply.text: Protein powder is a supplement, and I don't give amounts for those, so I can't tell you a number for how much is too much. What I can say in general: protein powder is a convenient way to fill a protein gap, and your total protein across the day matters more than any single scoop. If you're curious where your food intake stands, I can pull your food log and we can look at the protein you're already getting from meals. For how much powder suits you specifically, check with a doctor or dietitian.
